mapper.sql: id, factory, area, line, process, emp_no, emp_name, enabled, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT , ( CASE WHEN line = #{line} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN process = #{process} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS match_level FROM cps_area_person_config WHERE enabled = 1 AND factory = #{factory} AND area = #{area} AND emp_no IS NOT NULL AND emp_no != '' AND (line = #{line} OR line = '') AND (process = #{process} OR process = '') ORDER BY match_level DESC, id ASC

SELECT , ( CASE WHEN line = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END + CASE WHEN process = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ) AS match_level FROM cps_area_person_config WHERE enabled = 1 AND factory = #{factory} AND area = #{area} AND emp_no IS NOT NULL AND emp_no != '' ORDER BY match_level ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cps_area_person_config ( id, factory, area, line, process, emp_no, emp_name, enabled, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{factory}, #{area}, #{line}, #{process}, #{empNo}, #{empName}, #{enabled}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE emp_no = VALUES(emp_no), emp_name = VALUES(emp_name), enabled = VALUES(enabled), updated_by = VALUES(updated_by)
mapper.select: SELECT factory AS value, factory AS label FROM cps_area_person_config WHERE enabled = 1 GROUP BY factory ORDER BY factory ASC
SELECT area AS value, area AS label FROM cps_area_person_config WHERE enabled = 1 AND factory = #{factory} GROUP BY factory, area ORDER BY area ASC
SELECT line AS value, line AS label FROM cps_area_person_config WHERE enabled = 1 AND line != '' AND factory = #{factory} AND area = #{area} GROUP BY factory, area, line ORDER BY line ASC
